description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to tenant ID encryption and decryption, including validation of tenant salt, key derivation, and encryption/decryption routines using CryptoJS.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Validates that a string appears URL-safe base64 without padding and has length approximately 22-24 characters.

methods.name: stripBase64Padding
methods.description: Removes padding characters '=' from the end of a base64 string.

methods.name: toWordArray
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array or Buffer to a CryptoJS WordArray.

methods.name: deriveAes128KeyFromBase64UrlSalt
methods.description: Derives a 128-bit AES key from a base64url-encoded salt by decoding, hashing with SHA256, and taking the first 16 bytes.
